verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no maximum number of concurrent requests or connections for the local server, and no point at which throughput degrades. The only related items are adjacent: a pricing-page line about running multiple models concurrently, and a marketing claim that dedicated capacity keeps throughput steady for several agents, which appears to describe the cloud offering. Neither states a documented concurrency limit.

support.subject: As a developer, I know the documented maximum concurrent requests or connections the local server can handle before throughput degrades
